learning_outcomes.text: Students review the scientific disciplines working on traffic and the studies conducted.
Students can explain traffic by dividing it into its elements as a system.
Students can explain traffic laws in terms of their obligations.
Students gain awareness with the information they acquire about traffic safety.
Students can list the environmental effects of traffic, vulnerable groups in traffic, and their characteristics.

syllabus_topics: Human mobility / development of transportation systems from past to present

What is traffic? What are the basic elements of traffic? Traffic problem in the world and in Turkey. Traffic as a multidisciplinary field of study - which disciplines work for traffic order, system - how should multidisciplinary collaboration be? Current situation in Turkey - how does it work?
Traffic and law - traffic law, perspective on traffic laws in terms of fundamental rights and obligations
Method in traffic and accident research - information on how scientific research is conducted on traffic
How should traffic areas be arranged? Optimal designs that lead to safe behavior - perception - environment and road design and traffic safety
Environmental effects of traffic (on health - noise, exhaust, stress, crowd, density)
Alternative transportation methods - examples from around the world - rules to be followed
Human factor in traffic - performance and behavior - negligence, error, violation
Concepts of risk and danger - triggers and reinforcing factors of risky behavior - proactive behavior and self-protection skills in traffic
Vulnerable groups in traffic. What are the reasons why young people are at risk in traffic?
What are the reasons why young people are at risk in traffic?
Safety equipment required in the vehicle. Courses and addresses where knowledge and skills can be acquired
